comment: Design-system GATE POLICY. The token VALUES are owned by @app/design-tokens: the TypeScript modules in packages/design-tokens/src are the single source, and packages/design-tokens/scripts/gen.mjs compiles them (fail-closed on gamut + WCAG contrast) into the two committed adapters — src/generated/native.ts (the RN theme apps/mobile consumes via @app/design-tokens/native) and src/generated/web.css (the Tailwind v4 @theme apps/web imports). The styleguide gate regen-diffs the package (tsx packages/design-tokens/scripts/gen.mjs --check) so a hand edit to a generated file, or a retune that breaks readability, is a red gate — the token values, themes, and contrast contract are NOT re-declared here. This file carries only the policy the source scan enforces over apps/mobile/{src,app}: accentTokens/accentUsageBudget cap accent-token occurrences (the single-accent design dies by a thousand highlights); controlPrimitives arms the primitive-boundary scan (a raw JSX open-tag for one of `tags` in a .tsx outside `home` is red — controls render through the src/components primitives; controlPrimitives.base names the one touchable base where the pressable tags may be styled, and where the 44dp minTouchTarget floor lives; controlAllow is the reviewed escape); motionSeam is the ONE animation door (raw Animated/LayoutAnimation/Easing and literal duration:/delay: values red outside it + the components home); statusSurfaces requires a surface carrying one of `signals` to reference a status token (failure and success must never be the same pixel); allow exempts a file from the raw-hex/raw-dimension scan. The token names referenced here (accentTokens, statusSurfaces.tokens) are validated against the committed native.ts palette, so policy can never name a token no theme carries. This file is write-guard-protected: extending the design system is a reviewed human diff of the token source and this policy together.
